description.from:
Outcome: The projection writes to an output prefix that is separate from the public base path: sites/<tenant>/ in the shared bucket, the bucket root on a dedicated site. urls.basePath keeps its meaning (a public URL prefix such as /posts). Renditions (assets/responsive/), listing copies, _data/*.json, 404.html, robots.txt, sitemap and the Markdown twins all live under the tenant prefix. The renditions function writes under the tenant's prefix from the key it is given. Bucket objects get the S3 tag anthus:account and anthus:deployment so storage cost can be attributed (Prospectus cost accounting).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): src/papyrus_content/projection/writers.py, runtime.py, deploy_render.py, projector.py, standard/ (paths), amplify/publication/s3-projection.ts, s3-projection-settings.ts, renditions-function.ts, renditions-settings.ts, reproject-on-deploy.ts, src/papyrus_content/renditions.py.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-output-prefix.feature):
Scenario: Two tenants' pages never share a key
    Given tenants "alpha" and "beta" both publish "/about/"
    When both are projected into the shared bucket
    Then the objects are sites/alpha/about/index.html and sites/beta/about/index.html

Scenario: A dedicated site writes exactly where it does today
    Given a dedicated site with no tenant prefix
    When it is projected
    Then every key is unchanged (byte-identical listing)

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-daf673. Blocks PPY-3bbbf9, PPY-49d059, PPY-994bd0, PPY-413576. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-fea16f.

Testing: pytest on the writers; projection golden renders; a dedicated site key-listing parity check.
Rollout: Releasable alone (prefix empty on dedicated).
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a writer still uses the bucket root and overwrites another tenant's file. Mitigation: the writer refuses any key outside its prefix on a shared stack.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
